mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the copied chromosomes and then dividing the cell made the sequence of skin renewal clear. The descriptions distinguish two chromosome sets in one cell from two daughter cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the developing red cells returned no available partners, leaving me uncertain about how they would contribute until the body changed.

surprise.text: The developing red cells could join the body after skin renewal, despite having no available combination when I inspected them.

arbitrary.text: The required order of adding skin cells before developing red cells was not clear from the biology or the visible goal; I discovered it through compatibility feedback.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the linked descriptions of cell division and bone renewal made the body feel like a connected, changing system, although I would want clearer cues when a combination depends on an earlier step.
